device_name: iFuse INTRA Ti 3D Titanium Posterior SI Joint Implant
description: The SI-Bone iFuse INTRA Ti is a 3D printed minimally invasive titanium implant desined for use in the posterior percutaneous stabilization and fusion across the SI joint. If features a 3D iFuse lattice intended to improve bony adherence along with cutting blades and bone anchors to grip and compress across the SI joint. The implant featrues fenestrations to allow ingrowth of bone as well.
features: 3D printed titanium with iFuse lattice structure
Bone anchors to hold SI joint
Cutting blades to cut across the SI cortical bone
MIS implantation via a percutaneous posterior incision
